labels.label: T-abs-hoist-dual-cover/kb-0244-twin
findings: Report only, nothing merged (as the dispatch asks). Yes, the model module can import the ETT one. Causal.CExtConnexeCauchy.SubArc is ETT-layer, and its import closure does not contain Causal.Remarks.SingularRowsCauchyExt (ladder.import_chain: None either way), so there is no cycle. A scratch copy of Causal/Remarks/SingularRowsCauchyExt.lean with `import Causal.CExtConnexeCauchy.SubArc` prepended compiles clean under -DwarningAsError=true (/tmp, nothing written to the tree, 6.3 s). A file importing both modules shows no clash. The twins come in pairs. The model ones are stated over {X : Type}, universe 0 (section CurveExt, :158): causalCurveOn_comp_monotoneOn (:162) and causalCurveIn_comp_monotoneOn (:191). The ETT ones are universe-polymorphic over {M : Type u_1}: CausalCurveOn.comp_monotoneOn (SubArc :141) and CausalCurveIn.comp_monotoneOn (:169). Each ETT one has the same binders and conclusion as its model twin, so each model one is the Type-0 instance of its ETT twin. A later tidy can reprove the model pair as one-line citations, with statements unchanged, or retire them.
